FANTASY BASKETBALL PROJECTIONS
& REST OF SEASON RANKINGS 2021-22

Fantasy basketball projections and rest of season rankings for the 2021-22 NBA season with the ability to filter and customize rankings by ticking categories on and off. We now have three sets of projections. Our standard projections, and two new sets called BLEND7 and BLEND14, which blends our standard projections with a player's average over the last 7 and 14 days at a 50/50 split.

Want to create your own ratings and rankings? You can use any of the 16 categories available by ticking the categories on or off (below).

Think a category is worth more than the others? Use the multiplier below each category option to add adjust the impact of it.

Last updated: 18 October 2021 by Joseph Mamone ( @josephmamone)
